caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular swatch of woven fabric with a repeating geometric pattern. The pattern consists of alternating vertical bands in three colors: red, blue, and beige. The red bands are formed by horizontal rectangular shapes created with thick lines, while the blue bands contain a similar geometric structure with matching thick lines. The central beige vertical band and the sections of the bands separating the red and blue are filled with a black grid-like design. The woven texture is detailed, showing interlacing threads, and the entire swatch is set against a plain, off-white background. In the bottom right corner of the image, there is handwritten text in brown ink that reads: "Mary E. Humes Federal Art Project W.P.A. of Virginia."
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
